court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: Sessions Judge, Gadchiroli (Case No. not mentioned)
case_name: Sau Ekta W/O Kailas Sao vs Kailas S/O Nanaji Sao
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: The wife filed an application under the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, which was allowed by the Magistrate. The husband appealed against this order and it was set aside. The wife now seeks to quash this order.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the applicant to prove domestic violence.
legal_principles.held: Over and above that there was not a single complaint by the applicant wife regarding the alleged harassment claimed by her, either during the time of approximately three months for which she resided with the respondent-husband or even thereafter.
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005 — Section 12

legal_principles.principle: A decree for restitution of conjugal rights becomes final if not challenged or complied with.
legal_principles.held: Neither the said judgment dated 23.8.2016 was challenged by the applicant wife, nor was any restitution attempted, considering which the decree dated 23.8.2016 became final including the findings rendered therein.

outcome.final_order: The original order of the Magistrate allowing the application under the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act is restored.

keywords: Protection of Women from DV Act
